text.11:105: On the day when it cometh no soul will speak except by His permission; some among them will be wretched, (others) glad.
text.19:4: Saying: My Lord! Lo! the bones of me wax feeble and my head is shining with grey hair, and I have never been unblest in prayer to Thee, my Lord.
text.19:32: And (hath made me) dutiful toward her who bore me, and hath not made me arrogant, unblest.
text.19:48: I shall withdraw from you and that unto which ye pray beside Allah, and I shall pray unto my Lord. It may be that, in prayer unto my Lord, I shall not be unblest.
